cv2.policy: Deterministic image decode, resize and non-maximum suppression only inside an explicitly injected SHADOW world-card adapter; it cannot assign bridge seats or promote canonical cards.

faster_whisper.policy: Allowed only as raw ASR base. Bridge semantics, corrections and canonical facts must be produced by school-owned post-processing and evidence rules.

google.policy: Authentication and Google Drive transport only; must not make bridge-content decisions.

numpy.policy: Numeric tensor preparation only for the explicitly injected SHADOW recognizer and optional speaker sidecar; school-owned evidence gates remain authoritative.

onnxruntime.policy: May execute only an explicitly selected, SHA-256-bound local world-card model in the independent full-card reference channel of the SHADOW pipeline; never activates implicitly or promotes canonical output.

pypdf.policy: Reopens and validates the generated SHADOW review PDF only; it cannot add, remove, infer, or promote bridge evidence.

reportlab.policy: Renders accepted observed, explicitly derived, auction, and screenshot evidence into a human-review SHADOW PDF; it cannot make bridge-content decisions or promote output.

requests.policy: HTTP transport only; must not make bridge-content decisions.
